stem: In a certain lottery, on average 1 in every $10\,000$ tickets is a prize-winning ticket. An agent sells 6000 tickets.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Use a suitable approximating distribution to find the probability that at least 3 of the tickets sold by the agent are prize-winning tickets.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Justify the use of your approximating distribution in this context.
